subject: Supplier activation: invoice submission channel and template guidance
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Acme Payments <acct-payable@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Supplier onboarding — preferred invoice submission channel

Hi team,

Welcome — and thanks for partnering with Redwood. To finish vendor activation on our side we need to confirm your preferred invoice submission process and the exact invoice fields you can provide. Attached: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (please fill and return).

Two quick options we support:
- Vendor portal (recommended): secure upload, auto-PO matching, faster routing to AP.
- Email (acct-payable@redwood.com): good for small vendors or one-off invoices; may require manual routing.

If you choose email, please use PDF invoices and include these minimum fields on every invoice:
- Redwood PO number (exact match)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date
- Line item description, qty, unit price, line total
- Subtotal, taxes, total due
- Remittance address or remittance email
- Supplier legal name + Tax ID (TIN/VAT)

Preferred subject line for emailed invoices (if you email):
INV [PO-XXXXX] [VendorName]  — e.g. "INV [PO-123456] [Acme Payments]"

A few clarifications we often get:
- Multiple invoices against a single PO are fine, but please reference the PO on each document.
- For split shipments, include line-level quantities and dates.
- Attach any supporting receipts or delivery confirmations as separate PDF pages.

If you're open to the portal, I'll send an enrollment link and that will speed payments and reduce hold rates. If email is easier, confirm and we'll accept the first invoice by email while you enroll.

Thanks — please return the onboarding form and confirm preferred channel.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
vivek.k@redwood.com

Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf

From: Acme Payments <acct-payable@acme-payments.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — preferred invoice submission channel

Hi Vivek,

Thanks — Sara (cc'd) is our billing lead. For smaller partners we typically submit invoices by email (PDF) to speed things up on our side. A couple of questions before we finalize the format:
1) If an invoice references a PO but the line items don't exactly match quantities, will AP put the invoice on hold?
2) Are PDF attachments okay as a single-page invoice or do you need a line-by-line Excel?
3) Where should we send W-9 / VAT registration? Attach to onboarding form or upload to the portal?

We can also enroll in a portal if you send the link — just want to understand expectations for PO matching and payment timing.

Attached: acme_invoice_1001.pdf (sample).

Best,
Acme Payments Billing <acct-payable@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara@opencloud.io>

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
To: Acme Payments <acct-payable@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T10:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — preferred invoice submission channel

Hi — thanks for the sample, that helps. Answers below and a short checklist you can follow:

1) PO matching: We try to match PO number and line totals. Minor quantity discrepancies are typically accepted if the total amount ties to the PO allowance; material mismatches (>10%) may route to AP hold while procurement investigates. To avoid delays, add a short note on the invoice explaining partial shipments.

2) File format: PDF is fine for invoices. For complex billing (many line items or recurring usage) an Excel or the portal CSV template speeds processing; for now a single PDF per invoice is acceptable.

3) Tax docs: please upload W-9 (US vendors) or VAT registration (EU vendors) via the vendor portal. If you must email, send to secure-apdocs@redwood.com with "W-9: Acme Payments" in the subject.

Checklist for each invoice (recommended):
- Subject: INV [PO-123456] [Acme Payments]
- One PDF file named INV_[PO-123456]_[InvoiceNum].pdf
- Include Supplier legal name and TIN/VAT on the invoice
- If multiple invoices for the same PO, add "partial invoice 1/3" in the body

I've attached a sample template (sample_invoice_template.xlsx) to show the preferred layout. If you can enroll in the portal we'll also provide secure bank-detail submission and a view into payment ETA. If you prefer email for now, we'll accept your invoice and queue portal enrollment in parallel.

Thanks — looping Lauren and Marcus to confirm payment terms and enrollment link.

-Vivek
Vendor Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachment: sample_invoice_template.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Acme Payments <acct-payable@acme-payments.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.k@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.b@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Supplier onboarding — preferred invoice submission channel

Hi all — procurement quick note to avoid surprises:
- Standard terms: Net-30 from invoice receipt (clock starts when AP has a valid invoice + PO).
- Expedited payment: Net-15 available for one-time expedited codes (procurement must approve).
- Invoices submitted without a PO will be routed to AP hold until we get a PO or a written exception from procurement.

Portal enrollment: please use our enrollment form here: https://drive.redwood.com/forms/vendor-enrollment. The portal is the only secure way to submit bank details and W-9 securely; do not email banking info.

If you plan to send the initial invoice by email while you enroll, please include the vendor onboarding form and W-9 to speed verification.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

P.S. AP expects vendor remit emails to be remits@redwood.com if you're sending remittance separately (not the invoice PDF).
